title: oscore fork: split of types.rs state (SenderStateStore/ContextStateStore) inconsistent with monolith Context methods — blocks lichen-node lib tests
description: oscore-bar blocker discovered by worker-6 while validating the wall-clock seam (b7z9.37.1.2(c-ii) sibling): /home/mark/crates/oscore @1c56f30 has TWO parallel type worlds that cannot interoperate from downstream: (1) monolith lib.rs defines its own ContextId/SenderSequenceState/ContextStateStore used by Context::restore_existing/register_fresh; (2) src/types.rs separately defines SenderStateStore (whose methods take types::ContextId). lichen-node's test store must satisfy whichever trait Context methods require, but implementing types::SenderStateStore leaves ContextStateStore unsatisfied and vice versa. Also SenderStateStore is not re-exported at the crate root (lichen-node tests import it via lichen_oscore). REQUIRED FIX (fork-side, human-routed): consolidate — either move SenderStateStore into lib.rs's trait family (same ContextId), or make lib.rs use types.rs types exclusively; then add  to lib.rs. Without it, lichen-node lib tests fail E0432 (SenderStateStore unimportable) and any test implementing the store type-checks only half the API.
